name: ACT Coach
one_liner: Free VA app with ACT exercises, mindfulness audio and logs, made to practise between sessions with a therapist.
best_for: People already in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) with a therapist
Veterans and service members using ACT for depression, anxiety or PTSD
Anyone who wants free ACT exercises with no account and no ads
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (veterans press 1)
People looking for a stand-alone self-help program: the VA says it is meant to be used with a provider
People who want a therapist or live support inside the app
short_description: A free VA app of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy exercises, mindfulness audio and practice logs, designed to support therapy.
long_description: ACT Coach was made by the VA's National Center for PTSD for veterans, service members and others who are in Acceptance and Commitment Therapy with a mental health provider. It explains ACT ideas in short pieces, offers exercises and mindfulness audio for practising acceptance and values-based action, and keeps logs you can review with your therapist. The VA says it is designed to be used alongside treatment, not on its own. It is free, needs no account, and what you enter stays on your phone; the VA collects only anonymous usage data. It is built on ACT, an evidence-based therapy, but we found no published study of the app itself.
patient_summary: If you're doing ACT with a therapist, ACT Coach gives you exercises, mindfulness audio and logs to practise between sessions. It's free from the VA, needs no account, and what you enter stays on your phone. It is meant to support therapy rather than replace it.

pricing.notes: Free from the US Department of Veterans Affairs; no purchases or ads.

privacy.notes: VA apps send no identifying data to VA or third parties; entries stay on your device (anonymous usage data is collected). HIPAA doesn't apply unless you share data with a provider.

faqs.q: How much does ACT Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with ACT Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can ACT Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. ACT Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use ACT Coach?
faqs.a: ACT Coach is available on iPhone.
ACT exercises and tools; Practice logs; Mindfulness audio.
